name: HotpotQA
description: A multi-hop question answering dataset with distractor and full-wiki settings, containing about 113k questions. Distinct from Natural Questions and TriviaQA. No data is vendored.
citation: Yang et al. (2018). HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering. Proceedings of EMNLP 2018.
